title: Bluesky posts input
description: Profiles to read and how many posts to take from each.

actors.title: Profiles
actors.description: Bluesky handles (bsky.app), dids or profile urls. Example: https://bsky.app/profile/bsky.app

maxPostsPerActor.title: Max posts per profile
maxPostsPerActor.description: How many posts to take from each profile, newest first. Pagination is 50 posts per request, so the ceiling is 500.

includeReposts.title: Include reposts
includeReposts.description: Off by default: a repost is somebody else's post shown on this profile. The feed kind is reported in the feedKind field either way.

includeReplies.title: Include replies
includeReplies.description: Off by default: replies are posts the profile wrote to somebody else. The field isReply says it either way.
